[id="network-observability-netobserv-cli-reference_{context}"]
= Network Observability CLI usage

You can use the Network Observability CLI (`oc netobserv`) to pass command line arguments to capture flows data, packets data, and metrics for further analysis and enable features supported by the Network Observability Operator.

[id="cli-syntax_{context}"]
== Syntax
oc netobserv deploys the NetObserv eBPF agent on your cluster to capture flows, packets or metrics for live viewing or local export.

.Examples
[source,terminal]
----
  Capture dropped flows:
    oc netobserv flows --drops
  Capture flows from namespaces starting with "app-":
    oc netobserv flows --query='SrcK8S_Namespace=~"app-.*"'
  Capture TCP flows on port 8080 or UDP flows:
    oc netobserv flows --protocol=TCP --port=8080 or --protocol=UDP
  Capture TLS plaintext for a specific pod:
    oc netobserv packets --port=8443 --enable_openssl --peer_ip=<pod-ip> --privileged --background
  Generate all available metrics:
    oc netobserv metrics --enable_all
----

[id="cli-basic-commands_{context}"]
== Basic commands
[cols="3a,8a",options="header"]
.Basic commands
|===
| Command | Description
| cleanup
| Remove every netobserv-cli component from the cluster
| copy
| Copy the capture output from the collector locally
| flows
| Capture flows
| follow
| Follow the progress of a background capture
| metrics
| Generate on-demand Prometheus metrics
| packets
| Capture packets
| stop
| Stop a running capture (removes the agent DaemonSet, keeps the collector and its output)
| version
| Print the netobserv plugin version
|===

[id="cli-global-options_{context}"]
== Global options
These options apply to every command.

[cols="1,1,1",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default
| --context
| Name of the kubeconfig context to use
| -
| --kubeconfig
| Path to the kubeconfig file to use (default: $KUBECONFIG, or ~/.kube/config)
| -
| --namespace
| Namespace to deploy the collector and agents in (default: netobserv-cli, or $NETOBSERV_NAMESPACE)
| -
|===

[id="cli-reference-flows-capture-options_{context}"]
== Flows capture options
Deploys the eBPF agent as a DaemonSet and streams captured flows to this terminal.

Flow filters narrow which flows are captured, e.g.:
  oc netobserv flows --protocol=TCP --port=8080 or --protocol=UDP

Filters accepted: --direction, --cidr, --protocol, --sport, --dport, --port,
--sport_range, --dport_range, --port_range, --sports, --dports, --ports,
--tcp_flags, --drops, --icmp_type, --icmp_code, --peer_ip, --peer_cidr,
--action, --query. Separate independent OR-ed filter groups with a bare "or".

.`oc netobserv flows` syntax
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc netobserv flows [<option>]
----

[cols="1,1,1",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default
| --background
| Run the capture in the background instead of streaming it to this terminal
| false
| --copy
| Whether to copy the capture output locally when it ends: "true", "false" or "prompt"
| prompt
| --enable_all
| Enable every optional feature above
| false
| --enable_dns
| Enable DNS tracking
| false
| --enable_ipsec
| Enable IPsec tracking
| false
| --enable_network_events
| Enable network events monitoring (requires OpenShift 4.19+)
| false
| --enable_pkt_drop
| Enable packet drop tracking (requires OpenShift 4.14+)
| false
| --enable_pkt_translation
| Enable packet translation tracking
| false
| --enable_rtt
| Enable TCP RTT tracking
| false
| --enable_udn_mapping
| Enable User Defined Network mapping (requires OpenShift 4.18+)
| false
| --exclude_interfaces
| Interfaces to exclude; repeatable
| [lo]
| --get-subnets
| Label flows with the cluster's machine/pod/service subnets
| false
| --interfaces
| Interfaces to monitor (default: all); repeatable
| -
| --log-level
| Log level of the agents and collector: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
| info
| --max-bytes
| Automatically stop the capture after this many bytes
| 50000000
| --max-time
| Automatically stop the capture after this duration
| 5m0s
| --node-selector
| Restrict the agents to nodes matching this label, as key:value
| -
| --privileged
| Force privileged mode on the agents
| false
| --sampling
| eBPF sampling rate (1 = no sampling, capture everything)
| 1
| --yaml
| Write the manifests to ./output instead of applying them
| false
|===

.Example
[source,terminal]
----
  oc netobserv flows
  oc netobserv flows --enable_all
  oc netobserv flows --protocol=TCP --port=8080 or --protocol=UDP
----

[id="cli-reference-packets-capture-options_{context}"]
== Packets capture options
Deploys the eBPF agent as a DaemonSet and streams captured packets to this terminal.

At least one flow filter is required, to avoid high resource consumption. See
"oc netobserv flows --help" for the filter syntax (identical here).

.`oc netobserv packets` syntax
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc netobserv packets [<option>]
----

[cols="1,1,1",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default
| --background
| Run the capture in the background instead of streaming it to this terminal
| false
| --copy
| Whether to copy the capture output locally when it ends: "true", "false" or "prompt"
| prompt
| --enable_openssl
| Capture plaintext via libssl uprobes (hooks every container on each node; infra binaries excluded)
| false
| --get-subnets
| Label flows with the cluster's machine/pod/service subnets
| false
| --log-level
| Log level of the agents and collector: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
| info
| --max-bytes
| Automatically stop the capture after this many bytes
| 50000000
| --max-time
| Automatically stop the capture after this duration
| 5m0s
| --node-selector
| Restrict the agents to nodes matching this label, as key:value
| -
| --privileged
| Force privileged mode on the agents
| false
| --tls_plaintext_min_bytes
| Drop short TLS plaintext events before export
| 0
| --tls_plaintext_preview_bytes
| Plaintext preview length on exported events (0 = full payload)
| 256
| --tls_process_allowlist
| Restrict TLS plaintext uprobes to these process names; repeatable
| -
| --yaml
| Write the manifests to ./output instead of applying them
| false
|===

.Example
[source,terminal]
----
  oc netobserv packets --protocol=TCP --port=8080
  oc netobserv packets --enable_openssl --peer_ip=10.0.0.5
----

[id="cli-reference-metrics-capture-options_{context}"]
== Metrics capture options
Deploys the eBPF agent as a DaemonSet exposing on-demand Prometheus metrics, scraped by the cluster monitoring stack and visualized via the netobserv-cli dashboard.

.`oc netobserv metrics` syntax
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc netobserv metrics [<option>]
----

[cols="1,1,1",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default
| --background
| Run the capture in the background instead of streaming it to this terminal
| false
| --copy
| Whether to copy the capture output locally when it ends: "true", "false" or "prompt"
| prompt
| --enable_all
| Enable every optional feature above
| false
| --enable_dns
| Enable DNS tracking
| false
| --enable_ipsec
| Enable IPsec tracking
| false
| --enable_network_events
| Enable network events monitoring (requires OpenShift 4.19+)
| false
| --enable_pkt_drop
| Enable packet drop tracking (requires OpenShift 4.14+)
| false
| --enable_pkt_translation
| Enable packet translation tracking
| false
| --enable_rtt
| Enable TCP RTT tracking
| false
| --enable_udn_mapping
| Enable User Defined Network mapping (requires OpenShift 4.18+)
| false
| --exclude_interfaces
| Interfaces to exclude; repeatable
| [lo]
| --get-subnets
| Label flows with the cluster's machine/pod/service subnets
| false
| --include_list
| Restrict generated metrics to this explicit list, overriding feature-flag defaults; repeatable or comma-separated
| -
| --interfaces
| Interfaces to monitor (default: all); repeatable
| -
| --log-level
| Log level of the agents and collector: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
| info
| --max-time
| Automatically stop the capture after this duration
| 1h0m0s
| --node-selector
| Restrict the agents to nodes matching this label, as key:value
| -
| --privileged
| Force privileged mode on the agents
| false
| --sampling
| eBPF sampling rate (1 = no sampling, capture everything)
| 1
| --yaml
| Write the manifests to ./output instead of applying them
| false
|===

.Example
[source,terminal]
----
  oc netobserv metrics
  oc netobserv metrics --enable_all --background
----
